text:
violet: quick heads-up — planning a config-only push 01:10 UTC. scope: prod global staged. changes: shaping.soft_limit 0.87 -> 0.83, default_rate_limit 125->95 r/s, batch_target_msgs 18->9, request_timeout_ms 12000->9000. routing pinned to 'latency-optim' for rollout. canary in us-central1 for 15m.

ash: copy. what's rollback criteria?

violet: rollback if p99 > baseline*1.25 for 10m OR 5xx >0.5% sustained 5m. also abort on any host kvcache_evictions/min >200.

mgr-oliver: add synthetic probe hitting heavy-seq routes and dash panels. I'll block further ramp without manual sign-off.

deploy-bot: [scheduled] cfg-2026-08-01-Q -> canary(us-central1) at 1800000300

sre-noor: recommend ttl_warm_ms=10000 on canary for 5m to reduce cold-kv churn.

violet: applied canary to staging earlier; saw slight short-seq p95 improvement, long-seq throughput dipped ~8%. watch per-tenant impact.

deploy-bot: [canary applied] cfg-2026-08-01-Q -> us-central1 at 1800000325

sre-noor: 6m snapshot: p95 200ms (base 190ms), p99 780ms (base 750ms), 5xx 0.01%. no alerts.

ash: suggest slow ramp: 3% -> 12% -> 40% -> 100% with manual gates. ops ok?

mgr-oliver: agree. manual gates at each stage. hold 12m after canary.

deploy-bot: [rollout] -> 3% at 1800000420

sre-noor: alert: evictions spike on eu-west hosts at 1800000460 correlated with tenant-heavy-7. p99 there jumped to 1.6s.

violet: pause ramp. mgr-oliver hold further increases.

ash: tenant-heavy-7 uses long sequences; smaller batches probably increased kvcache churn. propose targeted per-tenant override: tenant-heavy-7.batch_target_msgs=18 and tenant-heavy-7.rate_limit=160.

deploy-bot: [hotpatch queued] per-tenant override for tenant-heavy-7 at 1800000505

sre-noor: hotpatch applied. eu-west p99 back to 740ms, 5xx normal.

violet: decision: do not full rollback. keep global knobs but add per-tenant exception for heavy long-seq workloads. update runbook: per-tenant override = primary quick recovery knob.

mgr-oliver: resume ramp after 8m hold: continue from 3% -> 12% with manual checks.

ash: tagging release cfg-2026-08-01-Q. add note to DM tenant-heavy-7 about override.

deploy-bot: [rollout resumed] -> 12% at 1800000560

sre-noor: monitoring stable at 12% for 6m. no new alerts.

violet: final notes for announce: "Config-only tuning to tighten shaping and reduce tail variance. Per-tenant exceptions applied for long-sequence tenants to prevent kv churn. Rollout tag cfg-2026-08-01-Q." Post summary after 100% + 30m healthy.
